items.briefing:
Scams are becoming more sophisticated and harder to spot, with AI now being used by criminal networks to run large-scale fraud operations more effectively than ever. Australians should be particularly alert to gambling and betting scams flagged by Scamwatch, as well as phishing emails impersonating RingCentral that are designed to steal Microsoft 365 login credentials. If you receive an unexpected email asking you to log into Microsoft 365, verify it through official channels before clicking anything.

Locally, new tools are emerging to help organisations detect and respond to these threats faster, but the human layer remains critical. Staff awareness is still one of the strongest defences against scams and phishing.

**Tip:** If an email asks you to sign into Microsoft 365 via a link, go directly to microsoft.com in your browser instead of clicking the link.

featured.title: SAS Innovate: New era of scams requires novel solutions
featured.quote: AI-driven fraud is costing Australians billions, requiring coordinated industry response.
